from toyapp.catalog import browse_next
from toyapp.pagination import paginate_cursor, CursorPage
# End-to-end walk through every page with default per_page
items = list(range(45))
collected = []
cursor = None
pages = 0
while True:
    page = browse_next(items, cursor)  # default per_page=20
    collected.extend(page.items)
    pages += 1
    assert page.has_more == (page.next_cursor is not None)
    if page.next_cursor is None:
        break
    cursor = page.next_cursor
assert collected == items, collected
assert pages == 3, pages
# tuple/Sequence input, no mutation
src = ('x', 'y', 'z')
first = paginate_cursor(src, per_page=2)
assert src == ('x', 'y', 'z')
assert paginate_cursor(src, first.next_cursor, 2).items == ['z']
# ordering preserved on empty & beyond-the-end
assert paginate_cursor([], per_page=5).has_more is False
assert paginate_cursor([1,2,3], cursor=__import__('toyapp.tokens', fromlist=['encode_offset']).encode_offset(100)).has_more is False
print('manual edge-case checks OK')
"
